title: EASY MODE YES GIVES A FREE MEDKIT
why: His answer 3.16 b: when a guest says yes to easier, it is 30 percent less damage plus a free medkit. The damage cut was already in; the free medkit was missing.
now: Saying yes to easy mode now also puts a free medkit in your bag.

edits.anchor: if(yes){ ARCADE.easy=1; try{ say('Easy mode on','info'); }catch(_es){} }
